source.archive_source: joinquant_archive/sources/2025年度精选策略/77.超强单因子策略（EBIT,EV）.py

frozen_parameters.rebalance: first trading day of each month at open
frozen_parameters.timing: always invested when at least one valid candidate exists
frozen_parameters.invalid_rule: exclude missing inputs, non-positive EBIT, or non-positive enterprise value
frozen_parameters.universe_proxy: all A shares listed and not delisted at the observation date

data_contract.prices: Qlib/Eastmoney adjusted daily bars with B-grade daily_valuation
data_contract.financials: local B-grade fundamentals_pit, selected strictly by notice_date and revision_sequence
data_contract.market_state: daily_market_state rows whose status/ST/limit components each meet B grade
limitations: all-A universe is a preregistered proxy for Shanghai Composite plus Shenzhen Component historical members
local EBIT is operating-profit proxy and may differ from JoinQuant factor library
Eastmoney may backfill later financial revisions into old announcement records

calibration.pass_rule: all metric and coverage tolerances must pass; otherwise downgrade to C and do not calculate post-publication performance

first_read_advancement_gates.relative_value_rule: versus CSI300 buy-and-hold, improve Sharpe by at least 0.10 or CAGR by at least 3 percentage points without drawdown worsening by more than 5 percentage points

hard_stops: EBIT/EV has no material value over EBIT/market-cap ablation and CSI300
less than 80% average exposure because the portfolio cannot execute
production financial fields cannot be updated reliably before each rebalance
